name: ODBCError
description: Represents an ODBC error generated by the most recent ODBC query.
remarks: The ODBCError object is a member of the ODBCErrors collection. If the specified ODBC query runs without error, the ODBCErrors collection is empty. The errors in the collection are indexed in the order in which they're generated by the ODBC data source.
example:
With Worksheets(1).QueryTables(1)
 .Refresh
 If Application.ODBCErrors.Count > 0 Then
 Set er = Application.ODBCErrors(1)
 MsgBox "The following error occurred:" &
 er.ErrorString & " : " & er.SqlState
 Else
 MsgBox "Query complete: all records returned."
 End If
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: SqlState
properties.description: Returns the SQL state error. Read-only String.

properties.name: ErrorString
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the ODBC error string.
